ConfirmedDefectCounterexamples.Claim: Independent grouped repeat runs shared a provider operation key.

SelectedFailures.Message: Expected activity.Requests.Select(request => request.Invocation.OperationKey) to only have unique items because external idempotency keys must distinguish independent workflow runs, but items {"sha256:fuwen-operation/v1:da904d85b3e0b0c1f6146dbe97231060821f981a8ec0e91586cfd8c2d9cb3eca", "sha256:fuwen-operation/v1:003245d958ce24d94d05ee86339e8b76040e5db15bfda00e89f8b576f23698cf"} are not unique.

ConfirmedDefectCounterexamples.Claim: Two distinct same-named ungrouped repeat regions executed only the first provider body.

SelectedFailures.Message: Expected activity.Requests.Select(value => RuntimeValueJson.ToJsonElement(value.Arguments.Single().Value).GetString()) to be equal to {"first", "second"} because both declared repeat regions must execute their own body, but {"first"} contains 1 item(s) less.

ExcludedClaims: The initial grouped fan-out path probe was already rejected by the existing group identity budget.
The initial dynamic oversized-path fixture actually fit; final static/dynamic boundary tests instead prove exactly 1024/1025 bytes.
The first package-consumer failure was an overbroad assertion over classification-only loop-control descriptors; it was corrected without changing runtime source.
CompatibilityBoundary: Old v1-v5 dynamic definitions retain their legacy operation-key contract; new independent runs should use newly compiled/admitted v6 definitions. Existing effects must not be silently rekeyed. Duplicate ungrouped repeat names and excessive provider identities are now rejected before registration writes.
